requirement_text: Median core-task completion ≤ 2 min; 100% of journeys pass on a fresh database
record_type: Playwright wall-clock timing over five disposable full-stack runs

method.database: fresh PostgreSQL 17-alpine volume per run, EF migrations applied before Playwright
method.output: POSTERN_E2E_TIMING_OUT JSONL, one record per named task per run

verdict: PASS - all 28 journeys passed in 5/5 fresh-database runs; the slowest median core task was 2,064 ms (review activity), well under the two-minute target, and no individual timed task exceeded 3,316 ms.
reproduction: Compute the median of durationMs per task from the JSONL file.
caveats: These are browser wall-clock measurements on local disposable infrastructure, not server-side Server-Timing values; the backend emits no Server-Timing header, so QR2.3's 2 s step and 5 s task legs remain separately evidenced.
The three timed tasks are representative core journeys (alias creation, activity review, admin KV sync); the remaining journeys assert correctness without their own timing budget.
A fresh database is created for every run, so the pass rate is measured on a cold dataset rather than against accumulated state.
